## Summary

With over 8 years of experience, started at Yapo.cl building components and
flows for a ~1M daily-user marketplace, laying strong foundations in
TypeScript, design systems, and testing. At Globant became the go-to
frontend technical reference across high-profile projects for Disney,
UNICEF, LATAM Airlines and British Airways — shipping Next.js applications
to production and serving as the architectural decision point within the
team. Most recently, as founder of WEBAI3, independently designed and
deployed ERC-20 contracts, a multisig vault architecture using Gnosis Safe,
and an AI inference layer on top of X402 and Ethereum.

## Skills

Solidity, Ethereum, Hardhat, Foundry, Gnosis Safe, Systems Architecture,
Next.js, TypeScript, React, Unit & E2E Testing, CI/CD, SCSS, Custom Elements
